cli.intro: OpenDebugger — analyze Windows crash dumps, resolve bugcheck codes, and export reports.

cmd.analyze: Parse a Windows minidump or kernel dump and print its summary
cmd.correlate: Group several dumps from one machine by bugcheck and trigger module
cmd.bugcheck: Resolve a bugcheck code against the built-in table
cmd.report: Write the parsed dump report to a file
cmd.audit: Print the append-only capability audit history as JSON lines

opt.limit: Max modules to print in human output
opt.timings: Print the milliseconds spent in each analysis phase
opt.dryRun: Validate the request and print the intended write without touching the filesystem
opt.title: GUI window title
opt.actor: Actor id recorded for every capability call (default: WAE_ACTOR_ID)
opt.actorKind: Actor kind: user or agent (default: WAE_ACTOR_KIND)
opt.actorSource: Actor entry point, for example cli, gui, plugin (default: cli)
opt.actorFilter: Only show audit records for this actor id
opt.capability: Only show audit records for this capability name
